_doc: stream_views off (Nov 2 11:40 local): the first capfix learner died and the second hung after update 1 with GPU 0 idle and GPUs 1-3 at 100% (docs/platforms.md page-streaming deadlock signature; lookout runs with it off). A platform knob, not a recipe change. farsight v2 capfix (Arm B of the score-at-cap A/B, 2026-11-02): farsight-v2-1v1's config with exactly one change: a capped game pays cap_score_reward 1.0 (score-based terminal reward at the turn cap) instead of truncation_reward -1 (loss for both seats). Everything else identical: block_pool 2 on obs v3, no_peace, omniscient critic, lr 2e-4 -> 1e-4, kl_adapt_target 0.01, seed 821, the same random parent (/vol/parents/farsight-v2-capfix/random-init.npz is a byte copy of farsight-v2-1v1's). Hypothesis: loss-at-cap in the first ~1,000 updates taught the from-scratch runs that elimination is the only path to +1 (no mid-game city growth); hero-1v1 trained with cap_score_reward 1.0 was 2-3x more sample-efficient. Original: farsight v2: from-scratch 1v1 4x128 with observation version 3 (opponent history) and the redesigned trunk-block global pooling (network.BLOCK_POOL_LAYOUTS layout 2: layer-normalized pooled statistics of 32 channels, a dense bias through a scalar gate at 0, added after the block's LayerNorm, in blocks 1 and 3 of 4) on Daytona (4x RTX PRO 6000 learner + PRO 6000 GPU-inference actors). Game and PPO settings = bighero / farsight (experiments/curio/configs/hero-1v1-scratch.json, 2026-11-01): real 2.17.3 rules, no_peace, a capped game is a loss for both seats (truncation_reward -1, cap_score_reward 0), omniscient critic, gamma .995 / turn clock .99, batch 262k, minibatch 16k, 1 epoch, lr 2e-4 -> 1e-4 over the last 25%, kl_adapt_target 0.01 (the adaptive scale that held farsight's KL). Platform knobs are main's Daytona set (send_thread off, stream_views on, no coded views / value devices / shape caps); serialize_gpu on as in lookout (the first 4-GPU collective hung once on a PRO 6000 learner; no measurable cost). training_seconds set at launch (hero.py run_config). seed 821.
